name: officeai
description: Connect major LLM APIs and local models (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi) into Microsoft Office and WPS Office on Windows.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@officeai/shared && npm run build --workspace=@officeai/addin-ui && node packages/wps-addin/sync-ui.mjs && npm run build --workspace=@officeai/gateway && npm run build --workspace=@officeai/desktop-app
scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace=@officeai/shared && npm run build --workspace=@officeai/addin-ui && node packages/wps-addin/sync-ui.mjs && npm run build --workspace=@officeai/gateway
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@officeai/shared && npm run test --workspace=@officeai/gateway
